newFeatures.text: Added a version monitoring system so users can see the latest updates for each system
Users can now view update history including old versions
Centralized the version monitoring data using GitHub so all LGU systems use one shared JSON file instead of separate copies

improvements.text: Made it easier for users to see what changes were made in each update
Improved tracking of system updates so users can understand changes over time
Improved maintainability by using a single centralized JSON source, so updates automatically reflect across all LGU systems

newFeatures.text: Added timestamp tracking feature for monitoring transaction processing flow
Created dynamic yearly DOC_TRACK[CurrentYear] tables in the Timestamp Database for organized transaction logging

improvements.text: Enhanced transaction monitoring by recording processing timestamps and workflow activities
Improved audit trail management by storing all timestamp transaction data in dedicated yearly DOC_TRACK tables

versions.title: Health Office Workflow and Corporate Multi-Employee Processing

newFeatures.text: Implemented one-to-many account structure allowing corporate employers to process multiple employees using a single account

Implemented automatic account verification through email address detection. If an existing record is found, the system prompts the user to retrieve previously saved information automatically. This functionality supports one-to-many employer procedures, allowing users with previous employer records to reuse their existing data when applying under a new employer.
Added new Health Office user role for medical requirement validation and approval workflow
Added new approval flow where applications are forwarded to Health Office after BPLO approval before proceeding to the next step
Converted medical findings input into file attachment upload for medical document submission
Added Medical Requirements payment module allowing taxpayers to select required medical types and pay online
Implemented restriction preventing taxpayers from applying for Working Permit without completed medical requirements
Integrated online payment process for medical requirements including EOR generation after successful transaction

Added new fields `MasterEmail` and `EnrollmentStatus` in the enrollment table of the SOS_BP database to support the one-to-many enrollment procedure setup. Also configured the module setup table in the SOS_CR database by adding and enabling the one-to-many setup functionality.

improvements.text: Enhanced system scalability by restructuring the standard one-to-one workflow into one-to-many employer and employee processing
Improved transaction workflow by adding Health Office validation stage for better medical compliance checking
Improved handling of corporate applications where employers can manage multiple employee applications in a centralized account
Enhanced document validation process through medical attachment uploads instead of manual findings entry
Improved taxpayer convenience by allowing online payment for medical requirements before proceeding to LGU processing

fixes: Fixed workflow issues caused by converting the system from one-to-one into one-to-many account processing
Fixed application routing issues between BPLO and Health Office approval stages
Fixed validation logic for mandatory medical requirement checking before Working Permit application

versions.title: Enhanced Working Permit System Modernization

newFeatures.text: Added application tracking and progress monitoring UI or design, so taxpayers can view the current transaction phase of their Working Permit
Implemented live tutorial UI guide for first-time users to help them understand the system process and navigation
Integrated Working Permit module into the WSP (Web Service Portal) login system
Added online payment process for on-premise applicants with account verification and validation before payment
Added Medical Requirement section allowing taxpayers to select medical type, findings, and examination date
Implemented automated email notifications for every taxpayer application submission, including BPLO approval and rejection status updates.

improvements.text: Enhanced UI and layout with a modern government-style design while maintaining simplicity and mobile responsiveness
Improved taxpayer data synchronization handling different yearly application scenarios between online and on-premise processing
Enhanced data entry trapping and validation for more accurate transaction processing
Improved file upload experience with modern attachment preview functionality before submission
Optimized uploaded image attachments by reducing file size while maintaining image quality
Enhanced email notification templates with modern no-reply styled email formatting
Improved digital Working Permit preview design with a cleaner and more modern document layout for both taxpayer and BPLO users UI

fixes: Fixed payment processing errors during online transactions
Fixed taxpayer data update handling between online and on-premise yearly applications
Fixed attachment upload validation and preview issues
